scope: Metadata-only protocol audit; no patient images, checkpoints, final labels or simulator executions opened by this work.
hypothesis: Training with declared privileged simulation state produces a frozen deployable planner using only limited preoperative imaging and permitted estimates that improves the full-strategy quality/cost frontier over strong search on unseen patients when independently withheld real anatomy scores the frozen plans.
causal_control: Paired privilege/no-privilege training with the same deployment actor, TRAIN patients, seeds, training cap, observations and action space; richer training critic/rewards/teacher only. Privilege must improve this contrast to attribute a gain to privileged training.

outer_roles.external_final_candidate: UPENN-GBM; individual eligibility and power/sample count unresolved

deployment_contract.primary: T1 MRI-only on BTC; acquired metadata/frame/coverage, frozen TRAIN-derived anatomy estimates, tools/access constraints, predicted cavity and past chosen actions. No CT claim on this cohort.
deployment_contract.secondary: Annotation-assisted track permits supplied annotations to every arm. If the same annotations score a plan, label it annotation-conditioned simulator evidence, not independent real-anatomy validation.
deployment_contract.forbidden: Withheld target/support/vessel/tract labels, pathology/outcomes, postoperative images, private rewards, ground-truth candidate masks/clearance, true future cavity/deformation, references through crop/access/normalization selection or checkpoint selection.
deployment_contract.ct_track: Acquired MRI/CT component only after SynthRAD source/role/frame/ancestry admission. No synthetic CT claim and no assumption of glioma strategy or independent skull labels.
deployment_contract.firewall: Separate train privileged state, deployed observation/model process, and evaluator process. Deploy code never receives evaluator truth. Search and learned methods share the same permitted source fields, estimates, uncertainty, candidate family and action horizon.
deployment_contract.negative_control: Swap withheld target, support, vessel/tract fields and world identity with permitted observations fixed, before and after a planned cut. Actor observations, proposals, masks, search scores/order, access/crop and entire frozen plan must remain unchanged. Evaluator scores should change on a positive-control scene.
deployment_contract.cavity: For preoperative deployment, cavity is predicted from the permitted model and action history. Exact simulator removal may train rewards but cannot masquerade as an intraoperative observation.

budgets.cap_interpretation: Paired 30s/156 and 90s/468 proposals for the next TRAIN feasibility check, derived from the historical ceiling; not validated full-strategy capacities. Choose/freeze final caps and outer watchdog from TRAIN profiling before SELECT or held-out runs.
budgets.horizon: TRAIN-only horizon sensitivity at 3, 6, 12, 24 actions; freeze a supported horizon before patient holdout. Horizon truncation retains residual and is not full-resection success.
budgets.offline: Freeze updates, environment calls, teacher generation, patients and seeds before fitting. Existing 3-action/2-update runs do not establish convergence; final training cap unresolved.
budgets.online_includes: cold case-specific preparation, estimation, proposals, model loading, search/inference/adaptation, replay and export; report each component and total; independent evaluator time separately.
budgets.fairness: Paired same patient/resources and common source information. Randomize/counterbalance arm order; report quality at matched total time and time to fixed SELECT-chosen quality. Offline compute and amortization separate.

metrics.primary: Paired patient-level difference in declared geometric utility (target removed - 0.2 non-target removed - 0.03 actions - 0.001 complete-tool path mm - 0.03 tool changes), scored on withheld reference anatomy at a frozen online cap. This is a geometric research preference.
metrics.guardrails: No new observed hard-constraint violation; report feasible fraction and all failures; geometric effect unsupported if available evidence cannot certify the relevant constraint. Predeclare tolerances/noninferiority margins using TRAIN/SELECT before final access.
full_strategy: ordered complete-tool poses and tool changes
target removed and residual by compartment
non-target removed and contacted tissue separately
metrics.statistics: Average seeds/worlds within patient; paired patient effects and patient-cluster intervals. PAT29/31 n=2 is a descriptive transfer pilot only. External sample count must be set using a predeclared effect/margin/power rule, never final scores.
metrics.failure_rule: Retain every declared patient and method. Failed preparation/timeout/incomplete audit has null outcome plus failure indicator, never zero; report coverage and failure-aware paired analysis. STOP is a valid separate zero-intervention policy, never imputed for failures.

stopping_and_abstention.hard: Missing required localization/coverage, unresolvable frame/source conflicts, unsupported tool/access, no admissible model plan, or observed input outside declared domain => reason-coded abstention.
stopping_and_abstention.uncertain: Choose model disagreement/coverage/fragility thresholds on SELECT, freeze them, and evaluate abstention-risk/coverage on independent reference labels. Missing hazards stay unknown; robust simulated success cannot certify clinical safety.
stopping_and_abstention.strategy_stop: Stop when the predeclared observed-model marginal utility/constraint condition holds; withdrawal must be represented or limitation explicit. Do not use withheld real residual to choose STOP.

evidence_layers.A_simulator: Independent code/geometry replay and held-out simulation worlds; conditional model evidence only.
evidence_layers.B_real_anatomy: Freeze plans before an evaluator reads independently withheld real acquired/annotated anatomy; report label ancestry, missing coverage, registration error, and scorer-model dependence. Reusing the planning annotation is not this layer.
evidence_layers.C_physical_clinical: Held-out measured force/deformation/cutting observations validate physical components; observed surgical/neurological outcomes validate separate clinical questions. Neither follows from A or B.

success_and_falsification.primary_method: Select one learned family and checkpoint using SELECT only; predeclare primary SEARCH comparator and budget before opening transfer/final patient outcomes. Keep all named arms as secondary contrasts.
success_and_falsification.external_success: On an adequately sized external patient cohort, paired patient-cluster 95% interval for the primary learned-minus-SEARCH geometric utility difference must lie above zero at the frozen cap, with predeclared feasibility/violation/failure guardrails satisfied. Alternatively a prespecified speed-at-quality primary can be used, never switched after results.
success_and_falsification.privilege_success: The same prospective comparison must favor privilege over its paired no-privilege training control to attribute the effect to privileged training.
success_and_falsification.negative: Equal/worse reference quality, advantage lost with limited inputs or under true-label firewall, only simulator-evaluator advantage, increased constraint violations, or excessive abstention/failures do not support the hypothesis. Preserve all these outcomes.
success_and_falsification.pilot: Two unopened BTC transfer patients are a descriptive feasibility check; no confidence-bound population-success claim.

reference_holdout.patient: All visits, derivative images, masks, repeated exams and known pretraining overlaps inherit one outer patient role.
reference_holdout.within_patient: In the MRI-only path, a source target mask may become evaluator-only reference after source/annotation ancestry QC, never supplied to that patient's estimator or deployed planner. Anatomy absent from the dataset remains unassessed.
reference_holdout.freeze: Plan sequence/contingent policy, deploy weights, selected access, uncertainty/stopping rule and all runtime traces are hashed before truth-evaluator access. Evaluation cannot retry or change plans after a reference failure.
reference_holdout.split_units: Simulation-world holdout, real-patient holdout, withheld annotations and different-site external holdout are distinct; report which each experiment actually supplies.
reference_holdout.pretraining: Record third-party model training ancestry; unknown overlap prohibits an untouched end-to-end generalization claim even if local splits are disjoint.
